changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A call failure has only a kind and optional HTTP status, recorded with its database time. Existing rows have neither field.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE llm_usage_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_call_failure CHECK ( (call_failure IS NULL AND failed_at IS NULL) OR (call_failure IS NOT NULL AND failed_at IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(call_failure) = 'object' THEN jsonb_exists_all(call_failure, ARRAY['kind', 'status']) AND call_failure - 'kind' - 'status' = '{}'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(call_failure -> 'kind') = 'string' AND length(call_failure ->> 'kind') > 0 AND (call_failure -> 'status' = 'null'::jsonb OR (jsonb_typeof(call_failure -> 'status') = 'number' AND call_failure ->> 'status' ~ '^[1-5][0-9]{2}$')) ELSE false END) IS TRUE) );

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE llm_usage_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_call_failure;
